messages:
Marcus Chen: Priya starts Mon 3/29 — quick week-1 plan below. Lina/IT: please chime in if anything needs prep. Key asks: laptop + VPN by EOD Fri, GitHub org invite, calendar blocks for intro syncs.

Lina Gomez: Thanks Marcus — copying a compact checklist for managers and HR to confirm:
- Pre-boarding (before day 1): laptop imaging request, GitHub + Slack invites, Okta + MFA enforced, access to redwood-internal and onboarding docs
- Day 1 AM: 30m welcome w/ manager, 30m HR benefits + payroll, 1h team lunch (virtual OK)
- Day 1 PM: account walkthrough, dev environment setup (repo clone + docker), first small task assigned
- Day 2: pair with buddy on codebase, infra tours (runtime & console), security training
- End of week: 1:1 recap, draft 30/60/90 goals

Templates: 30/60/90 example — week1: learn codebase + shipping a tiny fix; 30d: own feature & tests; 60d: reliable infra PRs; 90d: lead a small rollout.

Lina Gomez: For manager checklist items: add calendar invites, confirm buddy (Marcus suggested Ben), create ticket for Dedicated access if needed.

it-ops-bot: Please run `create-ticket --queue=it-setup --summary='New laptop/image for Priya K.' --assignee=imaging-team`

it-ops-bot: VPN onboarding link: https://internal.redwood/vpn-setup — enable SSO + MFA within 24h. Ticket created: INC-3421

Priya Kapoor: Thanks! Excited. Quick Q — I will need read access to redwood-dedicated to follow infra walkthrough, is that ok?

Marcus Chen: Yep — will add you. @it-ops-bot can you add Priya to redwood-dedicated-readers? Also assigning Ben as buddy for week1 pairing.

it-ops-bot: Added Priya to redwood-dedicated-readers. Created access ticket #ACL-890. Ben Liu added as buddy. :white_check_mark:

Priya Kapoor: Awesome, thanks everyone. One more — where is the onboarding repo with the "first PR" task? I couldn't find it.

Lina Gomez: onboarding repo is `github.com/redwood/onboarding`. Clone `git@github.com:redwood/onboarding.git` then follow README.md -> first-pr.md

Marcus Chen: I'll drop my Week1 calendar invite now and DM the rest. Ping here if any blockers before Mon. :rocket:
